name: azure-mcp
description: MCP server recipe for the Azure MCP server. Provides Azure resource management tools to Squad agents via the Model Context Protocol.

install.description: Idempotent install: `npx -y @azure/mcp@latest` downloads and caches the server on first run. Subsequent runs use the cached version. No global install required.
prerequisites: Azure CLI (`az`) installed and authenticated (`az login`)
`AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID` environment variable set to your target subscription ID
`AZURE_TENANT_ID` environment variable set to your Azure AD tenant ID
quickstart: export AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID=$(az account show --query id -o tsv)
export AZURE_TENANT_ID=$(az account show --query tenantId -o tsv)
notes: This recipe uses ${ENV_VAR} syntax for secrets — never commit real credentials to this file.
Re-running install is idempotent: npx caches the package and will not re-download if already cached.
For production use, pin a specific version: `npx -y @azure/mcp@0.4.0` instead of `@latest`.
